system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: enable-serviceusage
  type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:projects.services
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)
    serviceId: serviceusage.googleapis.com

- name: enable-run
  type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:projects.services
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)
    serviceId: run.googleapis.com

- name: enable-artifactregistry
  type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:projects.services
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)
    serviceId: artifactregistry.googleapis.com

- name: enable-iam
  type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:projects.services
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)
    serviceId: iam.googleapis.com

- name: enable-secretmanager
  type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:projects.services
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)
    serviceId: secretmanager.googleapis.com

- name: enable-cloudbuild
  type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:projects.services
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)
    serviceId: cloudbuild.googleapis.com

- name: cr-python-api-sa
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)
    accountId: cr-python-api-sa
    serviceAccount:
      displayName: Cloud Run Python 3.12 API Service Account

- name: python312-api
  type: gcp-types/run-v1:projects.locations.services
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - enable-run
    - cr-python-api-sa
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)/locations/us-central1
    serviceId: python312-api
    metadata:
      annotations:
        run.googleapis.com/ingress: internal-and-cloud-load-balancing
        run.googleapis.com/client-name: deployment-manager
    spec:
      template:
        metadata:
          annotations:
            autoscaling.knative.dev/minScale: '0'
            autoscaling.knative.dev/maxScale: '10'
            run.googleapis.com/cpu-throttling: 'true'
            run.googleapis.com/execution-environment: gen2
            run.googleapis.com/startup-cpu-boost: 'true'
        spec:
          serviceAccountName: $(ref.cr-python-api-sa.email)
          containerConcurrency: 80
          timeoutSeconds: 60
          containers:
          - image: us-docker.pkg.dev/$(project)/cloud-run/python312-api:latest
            ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
            env:
            - name: PORT
              value: '8080'
            - name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
              value: '1'
            resources:
              limits:
                cpu: '1'
                memory: 512Mi

outputs:
- name: serviceName
  value: $(ref.python312-api.metadata.name)
- name: serviceRegion
  value: us-central1
- name: serviceUrl
  value: $(ref.python312-api.status.url)
